item.description: इदितो नुम् धातोः 7.1.57 - 7.1.59 SV: none AV: none Language meaning: The verb roots that have इकार as इत्संज्ञक get a नुमागम Literal interpretation of linguistic meaning: धातु (carry till floats) with इ (below-like) are to be understood with instruction of नुम् (verb(pull) inside.

ह्रस्वनद्यापो नुट् 7.1.53 - 7.1.55 SV: ह्रस्व-नदी-आपः नुट् AV: आमि Language meaning: ह्रस्वन्तात्, नदीसंज्ञकात्, आबन्तात् परस्य आम्-प्रत्ययस्य नुट्-आगमः भवति Lieral Meaning: ह र स व न द य अ ओ of प न उ ट tight water gathered wave pull roll connect till detached from footing pull up coracle untill ins...

7.1.2 - 7.1.4 SV: झः अन्तः AV : प्रत्ययादीनाम् Language Meaning: The letter झ् occurring in a प्रत्यय is converted to अन्त् Reinterpreted: झ - vibrate instruction is replaced by अन्त् original instruction of “vibrating boat” is now to be replaced by “here log below pull”.

7.1.1 - 7.1.3 आयनेयीनीयियः फढखच्छघां प्रत्ययादीनाम् प्रत्ययादीनाम् SV: आयन्-एय्-ईन्-ईय्-इयः फ-ढ-ख-छ-घाम् AV: none Language Meaning: The letters फ्-ढ्-ख्-छ्-घ् occurring at the beginning of a प्रत्यय are converted respectively to आयन्-एय्-ईन्-ईय् and इय् literal meaning of linguistic interpretation: ...
नपुंसकाच्च SV: नपुंसकात् च AV: शी औङः Language Meaning: औ and औट्-प्रत्ययs following a नपुंसक अङ्ग get the आदेश ‘शी’.

उदोष्ठ्यपूर्वस्य 7.1.101 - 7.1.103 SV: उत् ओष्ठ्यपूर्वस्य AV: ॠतः धातोः Language Meaning: If a verb root ends in a दीर्घ ॠकार before which an ओष्ठ्य letter is present, the ॠकार of that verb root is converted to उकार Literal Meaning ॠ (superior) becomes उ up when it follows प फ ब भ म - rope/footing, ...
युवोरनाकौ 6.4.175 - 7.1.2 SV: यु-वोः अन-अकौ AV: none Language Meaning: The यु and वु belonging to a प्रत्यय are converted respectively to अन and अक.

6.4.63 - 6.4.65 आतो लोप इटि च SV: none AV: अचि क्ङिति Language meaning: The final आ of a root is elided before an आर्धधातुक affix with the augment इट् as well as when it begins with a vowel and has an indicatory क् or ङ्। Literal Meaning: अ ओ of त ओ of ल प इ [[ट] इ च till detach from float detach sa...

अतो लोपः 6.4.47 - 6.4.49 SV: none AV: none Language meaning: The अ standing at the end of a अङ्ग (stem) is elided before an आर्धधातुक affix Literal Meaning Explained “here” at end becomes invisible when instruction - Act of (causing(subjugate and carry ))- follows.

गमः क्वौ 6.4.39 - 6.4.41 SV: गमः क्वौ AV: नलोपः अनुनासिक लोपः Language Meaning: The nasal of गम् is always elided before क्वि Literal meaning of linguistic interpretation: “inside/fish” disappears, “move inside exists” (गमः), at “maneuver wave” (क्वौ).
